home.title: CodeX Intake 2025
home.description: CodeX is a team of passionate engineers and designers, unifying students, graduates, and other young specialists around the world interested in making high-quality open-source projects and getting a priceless experience of making full-valued products on a global market. Our goal is to make a team with fire in the eyes and idealistic tempers.
home.section1: CodeX is a small team of enthusiasts creating open-source products. We are currently looking for not just experienced, but above all motivated people who want to develop their technical and product skills and work together with the team on cutting-edge technologies. And who are ready to devote enough time to work at CodeX.
home.section2: We have a trial assignment that will help better understand your technical level and motivation. It will also allow us to get to know each other better and start your integration into the workflow. During the assignment, we will communicate and work together, and you will be able to assess how interested you are in working at CodeX.
home.section3: LLM models are becoming increasingly in demand and are being integrated into a wide variety of technological areas and products. We offer you to work on the cutting edge - try to create your own interface for interacting with the model. This is an exciting task that will allow you to understand the principles of LLM interfaces, practice working with streams, Markdown parsing, animations and rendering of various blocks. We hope that in the process of completing the assignment you will learn something new and gain useful experience.
home.section4: This is a common assignment for Frontend and Backend developers.
